<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def body_cage(fr):
    seg=fr.segmentation; nodes=seg['nodes']
    body=None; cage=None
    for n in nodes:
        if n['color']=='N' and n['pixels']==12:
            b=n['boundary']; body=(b[0][0]//4,b[0][1]//4)
        if n['color']=='W' and n['pixels']==16:
            b=n['boundary']; cage=(b[0][0]//4,b[0][1]//4)
    # slot states: check colors at slot cells
    slots={}
    for n in nodes:
        if n['color'] in ('b','g','c') and n['pixels'] in (12,16):
            b=n['boundary']; r=b[0][0]//4; c=b[0][1]//4
            if r in (6,7) and c in (8,9,10,11):
                slots[(r,c)]=n['color']
    return body,cage,slots
print("before:", body_cage(current_frame))
action(['DOWN','LEFT','SPACE'])
print("after:", body_cage(current_frame))
print("result:", last_action_result.get('board_changed'), last_action_result.get('level_completed'), last_action_result.get('done'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
